description: Ephemeral notification with a tone-coloured side bar and one optional action.

tone.description: The side bar's colour, and whether the toast announces assertively.

actionLabel.description: The label of the single inline action — Undo, Retry, View logs. Absent renders no action.

persist.description: Disables the host's auto-dismiss and shows the Pinned marker. Mandatory in an error state.

dismissible.description: Whether the × is shown. Both layers gate the × on this — Angular cannot detect a `close` listener.
